reasoning_content: Let me activate mise properly (mise activate) or use shims on PATH. Let's run hk install --global via mise exec.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && mise exec -- hk install --global 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "---"; git config --global --get core.hooksPath; ls -la ~/.config/hk/ 2>/dev/null
